title: Glowing diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#aef4ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5fd8ff' stop-opacity='0.18'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5fd8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,14 78,36 50,86 22,36' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
  <!-- top facets -->
  <polygon points='50,14 78,36 50,42' fill='#b8f6ff'/>
  <polygon points='50,14 22,36 50,42' fill='#5fcfe8'/>
  <!-- lower left facet -->
  <polygon points='22,36 50,42 50,86' fill='#4bb4d6'/>
  <!-- lower right facet -->
  <polygon points='78,36 50,42 50,86' fill='#8ff0ff'/>
  <!-- center highlight streak -->
  <polygon points='50,44 56,40 50,80 44,40' fill='#eafdff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <polygon points='74,20 76,26 82,28 76,30 74,36 72,30 66,28 72,26' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='27,62 29,67 34,69 29,71 27,76 25,71 20,69 25,67' fill='#d9fbff' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
